name: PeeringDB
covers: Every registered internet exchange point and colocation facility worldwide, with city, country, continent, and the number of networks present at each
note: CC BY 4.0, no key. A registry operators maintain about themselves, so absence is not proof of absence: a country with no rows may have no exchange, or may simply have nobody filling in the form. Rate-limited for anonymous clients, so every response is cached on disk.

name: PeeringDB IX-F member list import
covers: A second count of the networks at each exchange, imported from the exchange's own published IX-F member list rather than typed in by its operator
note: Carried on the same records as ixf_net_count. Used as the cross-check: an exchange the operator records as empty whose own member list shows members is a registry gap, not an empty exchange, and is excluded from the empty tally.

name: TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map
covers: Submarine cables and their landing points, as GeoJSON
note: Publicly served JSON, no key. Used for landing-point counts only; the cable routes on that map are schematic rather than surveyed positions and no distance is computed from them here.

name: World Bank World Development Indicators
covers: Population (SP.POP.TOTL), income group and region for each country
note: No key. Used to describe countries, never to compute an interconnection figure.
